title: French Language – Level 05
overview: French Language – Level 05 is an upper-intermediate language program designed to help learners communicate with greater fluency, precision, and independence in professional, academic, and social situations. Building on Level 04, the course develops nuanced expression, comprehension of extended authentic materials, structured argumentation, sophisticated grammar, and effective written communication. Practical tasks integrate listening, speaking, reading, and writing while emphasizing culturally appropriate interaction and strategies for continued independent learning.
audience: Learners who have completed French Language – Level 04 or demonstrate equivalent intermediate proficiency; professionals, students, and individuals seeking greater confidence and accuracy when communicating in French in complex everyday, workplace, or academic contexts.
methodology: Communicative and task-based language instruction; authentic articles, interviews, and audio recordings; facilitated discussions and debates; workplace and social role-plays; guided grammar discovery; writing workshops and peer review; pronunciation clinics; presentations; formative feedback; and integrated-skills assessments.
competencies: Sustained, confident spoken interaction on familiar and abstract subjects
Accurate and flexible use of upper-intermediate grammar and discourse markers
Critical listening and reading of extended authentic French materials
Clear, structured argumentation and persuasive communication
Professional and semi-formal writing with appropriate register and tone
Cultural awareness, pronunciation control, and independent language learning
objectives: Contribute effectively to extended conversations, meetings, and discussions in French.
Explain and defend viewpoints with relevant examples, qualifications, and counterarguments.
Use advanced tense relationships, the subjunctive, and complex sentence structures appropriately.
Identify explicit information, implied meaning, tone, and perspective in authentic texts and speech.
Produce coherent professional emails, reports, summaries, and opinion pieces.
Adjust vocabulary, politeness, and register to different audiences and situations.
Deliver organized oral presentations and respond confidently to follow-up questions.
Monitor language accuracy and develop an individual plan for further proficiency growth.
